capabilities: Hide Markdown formatting marks in Live Preview
Make list markers and checkboxes atomic editing units
Open files, wikilinks and bookmarks in new tabs
Customize status bar, ribbon and context menu commands
Delay community plugin startup with per-plugin delays
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not cut or reformat Markdown text; it only hides marks and adjusts editing behavior.
extras: Local-only with no network access; settings and cursor/scroll cache live in .obsidian with read-only mirrors in the plugin folder as a corruption fallback; changelog pops up after updates.
problem: Obsidian's editor shows distracting formatting marks, treats list markers and checkboxes awkwardly, misplaces clicks near callouts, and offers little control over tabs, status bar and plugin startup.

relations.evidence: Combined with custom-mark plugins like Task Collector, the completion state can be rewritten entirely from the keyboard

summary: Multi-module plugin that polishes Markdown editing: hides formatting marks, refines lists, tabs, typewriter mode, status bar, ribbon and lazy plugin loading.
